creative.brief: Open qualified enterprise conversations with banks, insurers, payment providers and large digital businesses for a controlled pre-transaction trust and fraud-prevention pilot.
creative.key_message: FORTRESS is being positioned as an API-first, explainable pre-transaction trust layer designed for white-label integration and multi-institution compatibility.
hooks: Can suspicious transactions be challenged before loss occurs?
A pre-transaction trust layer designed to complement—not replace—existing fraud controls.
Pilot the decision layer before discussing enterprise scale.
compliance_notes: Describe FORTRESS as a pilot/development proposition unless deployment evidence supports stronger wording.
Do not claim proven fraud-loss reduction without measured pilot data.
No malware-scanning, bank-grade certification, regulatory approval or security assurance claims without independent evidence.
Use NDA/IP protection before disclosing proprietary implementation details.

offer: Structured discovery + limited-scope enterprise pilot under NDA, with measurable agreed success criteria.
